description: How much calcium chloride raises your pool's calcium hardness, or how much water to replace to lower it, based on your pool size and fill-water hardness. Formula: Raise: calcium chloride (lb) = (target − current) ÷ 10 × gallons ÷ 10,000 × 1.2 for 77% (0.9 for 100%). Lower (dilution): share to drain = (current − target) ÷ (current − fill water); gallons = share × pool volume.

fill_water_ppm.description: Calcium hardness of your fill water (ppm); default 50

product.description: Calcium chloride strength (on the label); default 77; one of 77 = 77% (flake / dihydrate), 100 = 100% (anhydrous)

target_ppm.description: Target calcium hardness (from your pool builder or test kit guide) (ppm); default 250

name: calc_pool_calcium_hardness
title: Pool Calcium Hardness Calculator (Calcium Chloride to Raise, Water to Drain to Lower)
